ModMetaData.name: HSK Tactical AI
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
A custom raid AI for Hardcore SK (0.2, test release).
Raiders plan their attack instead of walking into your guns: - Threat map: they know where your colonists and turrets can shoot (toggle the overlay with the crosshair button, bottom-right bar). - Killboxes and funnels: they avoid them and make their own way in, breaching several walls at once with charges, launchers, breach tools, fire, grenades on doors, or tunnels through rock. - Open ground: they take a covered route, rush only with 3:1 odds or behind smoke, flank, or snipe from out of range and leave when an attack is bound to fail. - Combined arms: base of fire (machine guns, snipers) pins your defenders while the assault moves; overwatch on the breach; shield bearers lead and throw grenades; medics pull the wounded out; fire and movement inside each group; groups arrive together from several sides. - Fire discipline: aimed or snap shots, single, short bursts or full auto by range and role; realistic suppression (machine guns and explosives pin, armour does not stop the flinch). - Gas and fire against bunkers, arson, plunder (loot, livestock, wrecking) instead of chasing you into your corridors, planned withdrawals carrying the wounded, going prone under fire. - Tactical competence: how smart a raid acts depends on its leader's intelligence (Intellectual skill, traits like too smart or slow learner) and its faction's tech level. A sharp spacer commander uses every tactic and walks around your traps and IEDs; a dull tribal chief walks straight into your killbox and traps. Kill the leader and the raid loses its edge.
Every behaviour can be switched off in the mod settings.
Works with Smarter Raid AI, Combat Extended and Enemy Self Preservation. Not with CAI 5000 or Raid Tactics (they change the same raid AI; this mod has its own raid memory).
